neighbours.label: The hyphen piece inside a hyphenated compound where the tokenizer breaks the second word ('Long|-T|erm', 'high|-|temperature'), marking a word that continues across the hyphen; not the same phrase written without a hyphen.
fire: The report looks at the Short-Term costs of the new tax.
The bank published its Mid-Term forecast on Monday.
Delegates discussed the Cross-Border trade agreement for hours.
The city opened a new Pre-School in the old library building.
The government set up an Anti-Corruption office last year.
Students can take a Self-Defense class on Thursday evenings.
The study covers the Long-Term health of retired miners.
Researchers tested the cables in high-temperature conditions.

The city opened a new school in the old library building.
The government set up an ethics office last year.
